lam_default.note: Adversarial margins healthy for lambda in [0.5,0.8]; CB/ST real-data discrimination clears <=6.0/10 mean top-10 overlap at 0.7; CM does not (measured 6.9/10) -- see TEST_RESULTS.md RD-1. Per-request overridable.

kappa_min.note: Gate is inert on current data (measured kappa ~1.00 at P01 across all position groups). No empirical basis yet; do not present as calibrated.

kappa_band_min.note: Qualitative score bands withheld below this coverage. Needs an owner.

theta_pos.note: Matches the pre-existing compatible_positions adjacency bar so the engine gate and the repository pre-filter agree by construction.

modifier_min.note: PlayStyle/interaction effect sizes are UNKNOWN (no verified FC26 mechanic); bound kept tight so no single modifier can dominate capability. Revisit only if effect sizes become measurable.

playstyle_modifier_cap.note: Individual cap on the PlayStyle modifier's contribution to modifier_max/min.

interaction_modifier_cap.note: Individual cap on the attribute-interaction modifier's contribution.

tie_epsilon.note: Reuses the pre-existing SENSITIVITY_MIN_SWING noise threshold so there is one definition of 'noise' in the system.

reference_min_n.note: Minimum sample size per (position_group, attribute). Real data clears this by 36x or more in every cell measured.
